items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: They worked together. They worked pretty good while together.

ctx.x: I heard a lot of stories about him.

He's so glad he couldn't get him. I bought him a little fool with him, you know. Frankly the same way. I'm too crooked fellas. They're all down to themselves. So he got to Frank. They worked together. They worked pretty good while together. I think you told me once something about Buddy Petit learning on your horn.
Did you sell him a horn or what was that?
